g.title: py_soc
g.text: Bold = module, grey = instance in py_soc.sv. Purple = AXI4-Lite (32-bit), thick = bus master path, red = interrupts, orange = boot. Every window is 256 bytes (MASK 0xFFFF_FF00) except EXT (64 KB).

g.title: rst
g.text: sys_rst_n = rst_n and no watchdog reset
then a fresh boot from flash
